source_story.title: Platform Engineering Blog: Ranking Update Notes

slides.headline: 3X MORE SCROLLING.
slides.body: The average session length on short-form video jumped again this year, and nobody agreed to it.

slides.headline: THE NUMBERS BEHIND THE FEED.
slides.body: Short-form consumption is up 40% year over year, users spend 2.5x longer on video than on photos, and article reads on the same platforms dropped 18%.

slides.headline: WATCH TIME BEATS EVERYTHING.
slides.body: One signal quietly outweighs every other ranking factor.

slides.headline: FOR YOU PAGE VS FOLLOWING FEED.
slides.body: One is ranked by a model. The other is ranked by you.
slides.implication: For You: predicted, the model’s choices

slides.headline: "THE FEED ISN’T SHOWING YOU WHAT YOU LIKE. IT’S SHOWING YOU WHAT YOU WATCH."
slides.body: That distinction is the entire attention economy.

slides.headline: YOU’RE NOT THE CUSTOMER. YOUR ATTENTION IS THE PRODUCT.
slides.body: Every ranking change this year optimized for one thing: time on platform.

caption: The feed that knows you better than your friends do.
